title: Naruto
label: THE PATH OF A NINJA
description: An energetic young ninja works toward a future where his village will finally recognize him, finding teammates and tough lessons along the way.
longDescription: Naruto follows a determined young ninja who wants to earn the respect of his village and become its leader. Team missions, rivalries, training, and friendships gradually shape his idea of what it means to be strong.
whyWatch: A good pick if you enjoy long-running adventures, rivalries, training arcs, and friendships that grow over time.

title: One Piece
label: SAIL TOWARD YOUR DREAM
description: A cheerful pirate and his unusual crew cross dangerous seas, build unlikely friendships, and chase a legendary treasure.
longDescription: One Piece follows Monkey D. Luffy and a growing crew as they sail from island to island. Each stop brings new cultures, strange challenges, and people whose hopes become part of the crew's journey.
whyWatch: Try it for imaginative locations, a big ensemble cast, comedy, and an expansive world built across many adventures.

title: My Hero Academia
label: GO BEYOND
description: In a world where special powers are common, a determined student works toward becoming the kind of hero people can rely on.
longDescription: Most people in this world develop a special ability, but having power is only one part of being a hero. The story follows students learning teamwork, responsibility, and how to make difficult choices while training for a demanding future.
whyWatch: A fit for fans of superhero stories, school rivalries, team battles, and characters learning what heroism means to them.

title: Dr. STONE
label: REBUILD THE WORLD
description: After a mysterious event changes humanity, a science-loving teen sets out to rebuild technology one experiment at a time.
longDescription: When civilization is unexpectedly transformed, Senku uses curiosity, teamwork, and practical experiments to bring useful inventions back into the world. The adventure mixes puzzles and survival with a playful love of science.
whyWatch: Great for viewers who like clever problem-solving, inventions, exploration, and stories where knowledge is a superpower.

title: SPY x FAMILY
label: A VERY UNUSUAL FAMILY
description: A spy, an assassin, and a child with a secret of her own pretend to be an ordinary family, with hilariously complicated results.
longDescription: A secret mission leads a skilled spy to create a pretend family. His new wife and daughter each have hidden lives of their own, so everyday routines become a funny balancing act full of misunderstandings and unexpected care.
whyWatch: Choose it for warm family moments, light action, clever secrets, and comedy built around characters who don't know the whole story.

title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
label: AFTER THE ADVENTURE
description: Long after a heroic quest ends, an elf mage begins a quieter journey to understand the people and moments she once took for granted.
longDescription: For an elf who experiences time differently, a celebrated adventure is only one chapter of a very long life. New travels and old memories help Frieren learn more about human connection, loss, and the small moments that make a journey matter.
whyWatch: A thoughtful fantasy choice for viewers who enjoy beautiful landscapes, reflective storytelling, gentle humor, and character growth.
